meta.name: release-check
meta.description: Pre-release verification checklist. Validates features, tests, docs, security, and quality gates before shipping. Delegates to the Centinela (QA) agent.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 验证发布前所有检查项是否通过
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在发布前系统性地验证功能、测试、文档和安全。
copy.tagline_en: Validate all pre-release checks before shipping
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically verify features, tests, docs, and security before a release.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会运行发布前检查清单，依次验证文档、测试、安全等环节，最后给出“可以发布”或“阻止发布”的结论，并生成一份检查报告。
howto.when: 当你要求对某个版本执行发布前检查时触发，例如输入“/release-check v1.2.0”。

say.text: 帮我检查 v2.0.0 是否可以发布。
say.note: Claude 会运行完整检查并给出结论。

say.text: 对当前版本做一次发布前验证。
say.note: Claude 会要求你指定版本号。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude runs a pre-release checklist: validates documentation, tests, security, and quality gates, then outputs a final verdict (READY FOR RELEASE or BLOCKED) and writes a report.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a pre-release check on a specific version, e.g., "/release-check v1.2.0".

say_en.text: Run a release check for v2.0.0.
say_en.note: Claude will execute the full checklist and give a verdict.

say_en.text: Verify the current version before release.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for the version number.
